plan.true_optimal_reference: lexicographically first root action with Vstar-Qstar <= tolerance; evaluator only
plan.first_harmful_update: first adjacent root choice transition from true-optimal to nonoptimal; after-batch index is 1-based
plan.transition_scope: retain every optimal-to-nonoptimal and nonoptimal-to-optimal transition, including later re-entry
plan.signed_margin: same after-transition action minus fixed true-optimal reference at both adjacent boundaries; Qhat_gap=Qstar_gap+A_gap+D_gap when both rows observed
plan.representative_rule: minimum replicate_index, then declared arm order; no favorable trajectory selection
plan.scope: selected induced-error history diagnosis; not an independent cohort or a stopping/budget intervention
plan.secondary_policy_trigger: separately retain first evaluable full-policy zero-to-positive total regret and all later repairs/re-entries; unknown policy is not zero regret
